title: indigo_mount_starbook: MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES handler publishes the coordinates twice
description:
Owner request (2026-11-19): the duplicate is an obvious defect, fix it. Found by the survey recorded in ticket 42b85be0-1f19-4607-b3c3-746e60317d17.

indigo_drivers/mount_starbook/indigo_mount_starbook.driver (3.0.0.12), on_change of the inherited MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES: every path calls indigo_update_coordinates() itself (start failure with NULL, sync result and refused GoTo with starbook_error_text(error), accepted GoTo with NULL), and the generator appends its own indigo_update_coordinates(device, NULL) at the end of mount_equatorial_coordinates_handler, so every request publishes MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES, MOUNT_HORIZONTAL_COORDINATES and MOUNT_LST_TIME twice.

Fix: one publication per path through the generated epilogue. The error text that today travels with the hand-written update must still reach the client exactly once (decide how within the generator's existing semantics, without changing the generator; report the choice). Keep the state assignments, the restored position values and the scheduling of mount_goto_finalizer correct; inspect the regenerated handler. Driver version incremented, outputs regenerated. Tests: assert one coordinates update per request in each path and that the error message is still delivered; recorded run with tools/run_driver_test.py mount_starbook; MIGRATION_STATUS.md counts.

outcome.summary: Reviewed git diff 1c2d5cb3d4...HEAD (5ded940c4), worktree clean. Correctness: regenerated mount_equatorial_coordinates_handler (indigo_mount_starbook.c:700-735) now ends every on_change path in the single generated indigo_update_coordinates(device, NULL): start failure ALERT, sync OK, sync/readback failure ALERT, refused GoTo ALERT, accepted GoTo BUSY; parked guard unchanged (message + one INDIGO_UPDATE_PROPERTY_STATE, return). No hand-written coordinates update remains in the on_change; other handlers' on_change blocks only update other properties (TIMEZONE<->GEOGRAPHIC), ABORT/finalizer/poll publish once. Error text: indigo_update_property(..., msg) is itself serialised as update_property(client, ..., NULL) followed by a separate send_message(client, device, property, msg) (indigo_bus.c:1326-1331), and the XML adapter emits <message device name=...> either way, so the new indigo_send_message(device, MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES_PROPERTY, ...) yields the same wire message, once; only the order changes (message now precedes the update, as in the generator's own parked guard). No agent/client in the repo pairs a message with the coordinates update (client update_property callbacks always receive NULL). Finalizer: indigo_execute_handler_in queues on the same single-threaded device queue (indigo_timer.c queue_func), so it cannot run before the BUSY update. Generator: worktree build/bin/indigo_generator regenerated .c/.h/_main.c in a temp dir, all identical; no generator source change. Tests: new case passes 5/5 repeated runs; rebuilt against the 1c2d5cb3d4 driver it fails (refused START 2/2/2), so it detects the defect; poll and finalizer share the queue, grouping by trace count is deterministic. Full test_mount_starbook_simulator 27/27, 27 registered cases = MIGRATION_STATUS 27 / 0. Version 12 -> 13 (0x0300000D). README/TEST_SUMMARY: only the script record replacing the older mac simulator line. Non-blocking: the new test's cleanup uses brace-less 'if (driver_started)

history.text: Wrote per-path coordinates update counting test; building worktree to reproduce
Reproduced (3.0.0.12): every path 2 EQ/HOR/LST updates; message after 1st update in refused GOTO/SYNC
Fixed in .driver (3.0.0.13); running test_mount_starbook_simulator full suite

Reproduction and result (implementer). New case starbook_coordinates_request_publishes_once in indigo_test/integration/test_mount_starbook_simulator.c counts, with force_property_updates on (the bus otherwise drops an unchanged repeat), the MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES/MOUNT_HORIZONTAL_COORDINATES/MOUNT_LST_TIME updates and coordinates messages the handler publishes after its last simulator command. Before (3.0.0.12): refused START 2/2/2 no message; refused GOTO 2/2/2, message BELOW HORIZON with the first of the two ALERT updates; accepted GOTO 2/2/2 BUSY; successful SYNC 2/2/2 OK; refused SYNC 2/2/2, message FORMAT with the first update. After (3.0.0.13): every path 1/1/1 with the same state; refused GOTO/SYNC send their reason exactly once via indigo_send_message(device, MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES_PROPERTY, ...) just before the single generated update (the pattern the generator itself uses for the parked guard in this handler); the other paths send no message. Accepted GOTO: BUSY is the first publication after /GOTORADEC; mount_goto_finalizer is queued on the same single-threaded device queue (indigo_execute_handler_in -> indigo_queue_add, queue_func runs one task at a time), so it cannot publish before the handler returns. Other handlers checked: MOUNT_ABORT_MOTION publishes the coordinates once (no generated epilogue for it), mount_goto_finalizer and on_timer once per run, guider handlers update in exclusive branches; no other duplicate. Full suite 27/27; recorded run 2026-11-19 22:29 3.0.0.13 mac arm64 simulator 27/27 OK. No hardware run (no device).
Building and running test_mount_starbook_simulator (current and old driver)
